frontier_policy: newest candidates first; exact pins after security/build/numerical/consumer/resource qualification

kairos.owns: Rust simulation time/events/state/resources, DES/ABM, simulation RNG and replay

innovate.owns: innovation modelling/prediction: policy diffusion, adoption, competition, substitution, complements, hype effects, repeat use and innovation-specific game construction

voiage.owns: VOI and generic decision uncertainty, perspective/equity and reusable VOP decision capability

mars.owns: spline fitting and portable surrogate/model replay

uogto-semantics.owns: game-theory vocabulary, identifiers and semantic conformance

game-runtime.owns: one domain-neutral Rust game representation/solution capability; reconcile Kairos game solver overlap before promotion

careops-sim.owns: healthcare pathways, operational policies, local profiles and application validation

tobac.owns: tobacco-specific models, evidence and policy scenarios; generic methods promoted upstream

vop_poc_nz.owns: NZ empirical proof-of-concept scenarios, assumptions and demonstrations; not a competing general economic framework

new-drug-reimbursement-game.owns: reimbursement-specific institutions, payoff assumptions, calibration and research scenarios

repository-standards.owns: engineering policy, ownership contracts and qualification receipts; not consumer runtime certification

innovate.application: mandatory for new scientific work and next breaking supported release; current hybrid source requires migration
innovate.oracles: isolated external-reference environments only; unreachable by production dispatch

kairos.data_layer: optional Polars/Arrow; do not force tabular dependencies into the minimal engine
kairos.acceptance_note: each capability and consumer retains its own native/scientific receipt

voiage.direction: binding-independent Rust numerical/domain policy with Polars/Arrow consumers
voiage.acceptance_note: current hybrid and per-method scope must remain explicit; this policy does not migrate all interfaces

game-runtime.acceptance_note: Paignia naming does not qualify the incubator; extraction plus Kairos S01-S04 reconciliation and installed consumers remain required

promotion_rule: applications retain domain assumptions/evidence; reusable methods move to their authoritative library with independent oracle, public contract and installed-consumer receipts

data_boundaries.medicines_sources: Global Medicines Atlas/Reimbursement Atlas own acquisition, terminology and reviewed evidence; Innovate consumes pinned qualified projections
